full_prompt_en: A densely populated comic illustration centers on a thoughtful man in the foreground. His gray wavy hair, thick dark eyebrows and heavy black glasses are crisply outlined; he wears a purple jacket over a golden shirt and black bow tie. A chest-level crop makes his face the largest and calmest shape in the image. Behind him, dozens of tightly packed, individually sketched faces and small figures fill the entire background: people in hats and suits, masked adventurers, smiling women, and eccentric character silhouettes. The crowd rises all the way to the upper border with almost no blank space, its members distinguished by alternating small light and dark shapes. Black ink lines vary from precise clean facial contours to quick hatch marks in the distant crowd. A cream and muted gold ground carries subdued charcoal grays and occasional touches of purple; the most saturated violet appears on the foreground jacket. Several pale faces around the main head provide visual pauses, and dark hats and masks form a patterned backdrop. Light is graphic and even, with shadows described by hatching and restrained flat fills rather than soft photographic gradients. The central face has carefully drawn structure and a direct, introspective gaze. The surface has the energy and slightly worn paper texture of a printed comic page. The full square reads immediately as one striking portrait, then reward closer looking with its crowded miniature world.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅人物极密集的漫画插画，中心是前景一位沉思的男子。他卷曲灰发、浓黑眉毛和厚黑框眼镜都有清晰轮廓；穿紫色外套、金黄色衬衫与黑色领结。胸部以上的裁切使他的脸成为画面中最大、最安静的形状。身后的整个背景填满数十张紧挨着、各有描绘的脸和小人物：戴帽穿西装者、蒙面冒险者、微笑的女性与古怪的角色剪影。人群一直升到上边缘，几乎没有空白，却通过大小明暗形的交替辨出个体。黑墨线从准确的面部轮廓变化到远处人群中快速的排线。底色为乳白和柔和金色，辅以克制的炭灰与偶见紫色；最饱和的紫留给前景外套。主角头部周围的几张浅色面孔构成视觉停顿，深色帽子和面罩构成花纹般的背景。光线是平稳的图形化照明，阴影由排线和少量平涂表示，而非柔软照片渐变。主角面容结构仔细，目光直接而内省。画面具有印刷漫画页的活力和略旧的纸张肌理。整幅正方形远看是一幅醒目肖像，近看又可发现拥挤的微型世界。
style_prompt_en: Dense inked comic illustration on warm printed paper combines bold foreground contours with miniature background linework, variable hatching, restrained flat color, muted gold and cream, charcoal gray, and selective violet. Many distinct silhouettes compress into one readable field. Graphic lighting is even, and changing line density creates depth across the square image.
style_prompt_zh: 暖色印刷纸上的密集墨线漫画插画，前景轮廓粗而明确，背景线稿微小繁多，排线疏密变化，平涂色克制，以柔和金、乳白、炭灰和选择性的紫色为主。许多各异轮廓压缩在一个仍可读的画面中，图形化照明平稳，线条密度变化制造正方形画面的纵深。
theme_en: A bespectacled man before an impossibly dense crowd of comic characters
theme_zh: 戴眼镜男子立于密集漫画人物群前
name: Mike Allred
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
